name: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship
provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (via Campus France)
amount: Monthly allowance (about €1,200 for Master's, about €1,700 for PhD in recent rounds), travel, health insurance, cultural activities
deadline: Universities submit nominations by early January 2027 — apply to your French university first (often Nov–Dec)
description: France's flagship scholarship for top international students. You don't apply directly: you apply to a French institution, and the institution nominates you. Strongest fields include engineering, law, economics, management and political science.
tips: Contact the international office of your target university in October and ask about their internal Eiffel deadline.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Scholarships
amount: €1,400 per month, tuition, travel and installation costs
deadline: Varies by programme — most close between October and February
description: Two-year Master's programmes taught in English across two or more European countries, many with a French partner university. Each programme runs its own selection.
tips: Use the official catalogue and filter by France. Apply to up to three programmes per year.

name: Campus Bourses scholarship search
amount: Hundreds of scholarships from the French government, regions, universities and companies
deadline: Each scholarship has its own deadline
description: The official database of scholarships for studying in France. Filter by nationality, level and field to see what you are eligible for.
tips: Search with 'Pakistan' (or your country) as nationality — results change a lot.

name: Université Paris-Saclay International Master's Scholarships
amount: Monthly stipend for the Master's year(s), plus travel support
deadline: Usually linked to the Master's application window (winter–spring)
description: Excellence scholarships for strong international applicants to Paris-Saclay Master's programmes.
tips: Tick the scholarship box when applying to the Master's — there is often no separate form.

name: Université Grenoble Alpes Master's Scholarships
deadline: Usually winter–spring, depending on the programme
description: Excellence scholarships for international students admitted to eligible UGA Master's programmes, including several taught in English.
tips: Check each Master's page for its scholarship section.

name: Ampère Scholarships of Excellence
description: For excellent international students admitted to a Master's at ENS de Lyon, in sciences or humanities.
tips: Strong academic record and a research-oriented project matter most.

name: Émile Boutmy Scholarship
amount: Tuition reduction and/or a yearly grant
deadline: Same as the Sciences Po admission deadline
description: Sciences Po's main scholarship for high-achieving non-EU students admitted to its Bachelor's or Master's programmes.
tips: Many Sciences Po Master's programmes are fully in English.

name: Institut Polytechnique de Paris Master's Scholarships
deadline: Linked to the Master's application rounds
description: Scholarships for international students in IP Paris Master's programmes, most of which are taught in English.
tips: Apply in the earliest round — more funding is available.

name: Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Networks
amount: Full PhD salary with social security, mobility and family allowances
description: Paid PhD positions in European research networks, many hosted in French labs. You apply to a specific open position.
tips: Search EURAXESS for 'MSCA' and filter by France.

name: French Government Scholarships for Pakistan
amount: Depends on the programme (stipends, fee support, research stays)
description: Scholarships and co-funded programmes managed by the French Embassy and Campus France Pakistan. Announcements change each year.
tips: Follow Campus France Pakistan and the Embassy's social media for announcements.

name: HEC Pakistan Overseas Scholarships
amount: Tuition, living allowance, travel (service bond applies)
description: HEC runs overseas Master's and PhD scholarship schemes; some phases include France as a destination.
tips: Read the bond conditions carefully before applying.

name: University tuition fee waivers
amount: Full or partial waiver of the higher non-EU fees
description: Public universities can exempt a share of international students from the higher fees (capped at 30% in 2026/27 and falling in later years), so waivers are getting harder to get.
tips: Ask the international office about the waiver as soon as you receive your admission.
